correctness.rationale: For n divisible by 6, all 57 nontrivial direction subsets yield rational polygons nP_S with lattice vertices for 6P_S; exact Pick/Ehrhart coefficients sum to M_j: (60u+15,39u+20,21u+15,7u+6,u+1) for j=2..6. Binomial inversion gives t2=14u,t3=5u,t4=u,t5=u,t6=u+1, plus six infinity points of multiplicity 2n+1; d=12n+6. Substitution in standard logarithmic Chern expressions gives c1²=86n²+62n-13 and c2=36n²+24n-4, hence limit 43/18. Independent exact primitive-projective incidence enumeration reproduced the full census, Chern numbers and pair identity at n=6 and 12. The published Eterović–Figueroa–Urzúa density lemma then gives [2,43/18]. It is a lower interval and not optimality.
